captions.detailed: A spotting scope in olive green and black, mounted on a pan-tilt tripod head. The tripod features three black legs with adjustable extension, while the head includes a long, curved panning handle. The spotting scope is angled upwards at the eyepiece and has a large objective lens at the front. It articulates via a continuous revolute joint for panning, a revolute joint for tilting, and three prismatic joints for extending the tripod legs.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a spotting scope mounted on a pan-tilt tripod. The spotting scope should have an olive green body with a black eyepiece and objective lens, mounted on a black tripod. Incorporate a continuous revolute joint for panning, a revolute joint with limits for tilting, and three prismatic joints for extending each tripod leg.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first creating a tripod base with three leg joints, each using a prismatic articulation to connect an upper leg segment to an extending lower leg segment. A pan-tilt head is mounted on the tripod base, featuring a continuous revolute joint around the Z-axis for panning, complete with a long handle. On top of this head, a revolute joint around the Y-axis enables tilting of the spotting scope. The spotting scope is modeled using combined cylinder and box primitives to form the main olive green barrel, the black objective lens, and an angled black eyepiece.
